run_soft_body_simulation: run a pybullet simulation that loads a soft body mesh, a plane, and a rigid box
load_soft_body_mesh: load a soft body from an OBJ file using pybullet loadSoftBody
load_urdf_rigid_body: load a URDF rigid body like a cube or plane using pybullet loadURDF
set_gravity: set the gravity vector for the pybullet physics simulation
change_dynamics_mass: change the mass of a loaded rigid body using pybullet changeDynamics
